title: Shade-Slayer Cloak
summary: While Hiding, reduce the critical-hit threshold by 1.

fields.Stealthy Critical: While Hiding, reduce the attack roll needed for a critical hit by 1. This stacks with other critical threshold reductions. The linked source reports the granted condition can remain after removing the cloak.
fields.Acquisition: Buy from Sticky Dondo in the Guildhall.
fields.Base value: 360 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
